brz_chef.text: Full English at any hour. The Airbridge has no clock: there's always someone landing, someone leaving and someone starving.
The secret is the bacon. Two rashers per person on the way out, three on the way back.

brz_padre.text: I'm the station Padre. The job is mainly listening and tea. I've married a few and held hands with a great many people about to fly for the first time.
Remember that the best landing is the one you walk away from. And the best take-off is the one with the tea still hot.
